Name: To-Dew Notes - Autosave and Restore
Author: Aeharnt
Description:
Keeps backups of your To-Dew notes while you play. If you restart a day or quit without saving, it can offer to restore your backed-up list when you reload.

Restore with completion checkmarks intact or clear them for a fresh day. Recovery replaces the whole list and saves a safety copy first. You can also keep your current notes or decide later.

Keeps about 20 recent versions per farm, plus protected recovery and safety copies. [b]Only To-Dew notes are restored. This does not save game progress.[/b]

[b]Requirements:[/b] Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b], SMAPI [b]4.5.2[/b], and To-Dew [b]2.6.3[/b]. Single-player only. 

[b]Installation:[/b] Extract into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder alongside To-Dew, then launch through SMAPI.
Backups stay in
[code]ToDewAutosaveRestore/data[/code]
